title: Narrating a Living Tradition
grammar: Combining iterative verbal aspect and generational expressions in storytelling
goal: I can orchestrate frequentative (-gat/-get), contemplative (-dogál/-degél), and instantaneous (-int/-ant) verbs within a single narrative
I can analyze the philosophical humor and Transylvanian regional voice of Áron Tamási's Ábel a rengetegben
I can write an evocative narrative about cultural roots and belonging
